fusions.name: Spore-Packed Head
fusions.desc: You rap an enemy with the spore-caked head of the staff, dealing 10 damage and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Ripe for Picking
fusions.desc: You jab the staff into a spore-ridden enemy at or below 30% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. It deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction you have on it, each one adding 60% more damage.

fusions.name: Ring of Caps
fusions.desc: You plant the staff and a ring of mushrooms springs up round it for 8 seconds. It restores 3 health a second to you and every ally within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Grows on Anything
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.
